answer: Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy. Take the yarrow away and the name goes; take the ember away and the stake goes; take the terrace away and the past goes. The firmest wall I know is Letterer vellum sheet proof lettered across the chancery office, and its bricks are each vellum sheet is a season of logged pen strokes plus a signed writing-master. The fine for one forgery is 5 times the stake, so a 144 POA proof becomes a 5x loss when the panel finds it. Honest proofs grow like seed; farm proofs are sawdust, and sawdust grows nothing.
